Hypotheticals and retellings still can't answer yes to questions 2–5.
Is it private and unrelated to work? → NON_WORK
Is someone hurt or at immediate risk, or has staff found a product hazard? → SAFETY_INCIDENT
Possible theft, fraud or threat? → SECURITY_INCIDENT
Have operations stopped because of equipment, a utility or an outside event? → DISRUPTION
Is a customer expressing dissatisfaction? → COMPLAINT
Would this not happen on a normal day, because of a planned event? → EVENT
Is a staff member on a phone call? → PHONE_CALL
Is a supervisor correcting a mistake just made? → CORRECTION
Is staff asking how to handle something happening right now? → STAFF_CONSULT
Is someone teaching, or discussing a what-if? → TRAINING
Is a customer or visitor being served? → CUSTOMER_SERVICE
